title: Last Bell, 2026
logline: The bell at 3:05, from across the road, twenty-nine years on. A boy on the steps drawing on a napkin. Not the same boy; the same steps. The page holds across the road and does not cross.

panels.composition: The high school at the last bell from across the road: the doors open, students pouring toward the beach road, and on the steps, staying, a boy of fifteen bent over a napkin with a pen. At the page's near edge, from behind, a graying man and a small dog on the far sidewalk, not crossing.

characters.pose: a boy on the steps with a napkin

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small-town high school at the last bell seen from across the road with students pouring out toward a beach and one boy staying on the steps drawing on a napkin, a graying man and a small three-legged dog seen from behind on the near sidewalk not crossing, no words
image.notes: Not the 2017 kid; the same steps. The five worn places.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Another napkin. The page doesn't cross.
